source_metadata.title: Optimizing the Dosing of Heparin for Therapeutic Anticoagulation in Neurocritical Care Patients at High Risk of Bleeding: Report on a Quality Improvement Initiative

extraction_limitations: Single-center quality-improvement report with a historical comparator; atoms preserve reported observations and do not convert appraisal into study findings.
Figure 1 contains a cohort-labeling inconsistency in the tabulated inset ("Quality Improvement Cohort" and "Pilot Cohort") relative to the manuscript's historical/QI terminology.

The April 2021 follow-up paragraph reports 120 total aPTT measurements but uses denominators of 128 and 124 for subtherapeutic and supratherapeutic counts; these were preserved as reported and flagged.

The current LiteratureAtom schema has no dedicated quality-improvement implementation atom kind; institutional implementation statements are represented with METHOD, QUALITATIVE_RESULT, OTHER, or AUTHOR_CONCLUSION as appropriate.
